description: Scan a public host's TLS from the internet: certificate validity, chain completeness, expiry date, hostname match, enabled protocols (TLS 1.0–1.3), cipher suites, HSTS. Use when browsers show certificate errors, before/after renewing or rotating a certificate, or to confirm old TLS versions are disabled. Use this (not check_http) for anything about the certificate or TLS configuration itself; works on any TLS port, not only 443. Returns a verdict, findings with cause and fix, and a shareable report link. Takes up to ~60 s.

host.description: Public hostname to scan, without scheme or path, e.g. example.com

name: check_tls

error.description: Error code when ok is false

ok.description: false when the check could not run (see error / message)

title: TLS / certificate check
